column2: I don't have the voice for the violin,
Piano keys aplenty, that’s not my spin,
Trumpets and clarinets, they play so pure,
But their sounds, they’re just too demure.
Guitar and drums, they're not my scene,
They get on my nerves, and that’s keen,
The drums leave me in a daze,
And the harp is too complex to praise.
So here’s my song without a single instrument,
To make you laugh and dance, without fear.
